resetSessionToken removes the previous session token and issues a replacement token after successful authentication.
Every diagnostic endpoint MUST encrypt traffic in transit, including endpoints on a local network.
Local diagnostic endpoints may use unencrypted transport for debugging on a trusted network.
Retry idempotent requests after transient network failures, using exponential backoff and random jitter.
Never automatically repeat a payment submission without an idempotency key: a second attempt can charge the customer twice.
Cached responses expire after sixty seconds. Purge an entry immediately when its source record changes.
The browser stores static images in its disk cache for one day. Reload to refresh a stale image.
Rotate the signing key every ninety days.
Rotate the signing key every thirty days.
To repair a failed import, retry the individual rows rejected by the schema validator.
